mappings.meaning: Wait for the platform-produced arena-ready bit before starting the boss delay.
Install active battle and record EndBoss music after the entry delay.
Shared return for boss, platform and helper early-exit branches.
Run a boss state, consume its self-hit latch and collision-draw.
Six relative WORD states for emergence, stream attacks and submerge timing.
Initialize the fourteen-hit boss and its normal graphic attachments.
Integrate emergence until nonnegative vertical speed reaches Y0x600.
Return before the emergence landing gate succeeds.
Clamp emergence height and prepare the timed three-projectile stream cycle.
Write the WORD direction whose two bytes also encode stream direction and activity.
Return after trying the stream platform producer.
Advance stream age, match sampled lava height and wait for shot callbacks.
Attempt three normal projectile/effect groups on progressively shorter waits.
Install the long stream hold after the three shot attempts.
Stop pressure growth and switch to pressure-drain waiting.
Follow lava while waiting for the arena pressure WORD to drain.
Integrate the boss downward during its timed submerge stage.
Select a stationary timed pause before the next emergence.
Wait for the next emergence callback without integrating velocity.
Restart gravity emergence and toggle the side used by the next lava stream.
Commit the selected side X and play the emergence cue.
Sink the defeated boss until its signed countdown underflows.
Signal boss-scene completion and independently attempt the upside-down Egg Capsule.
Independently attempt the palette actor that waits for capsule opening.
Load Egg Capsule graphics after both optional completion allocations.
Wait for global completion handshake then install a permanent idle and begin route restoration.
Restore player controls and independently attempt camera maximum-X expansion.
Attempt a standalone StartNewLevel trigger after completion.
Return after the one-time completion setup allocations.
Keep the completed root actor as an inert shared-handle occupant.
Initialize a stream-platform producer at the side selected by active direction BYTE.
Store the spawn edge and attempt the first platform without a failure guard for its saved handle.
Spawn another stream platform when the last remembered one moves far enough away.
Require at least128 integer X pixels of separation before another attempt.
Return after a stream-platform allocation attempt.
Shared immediate deletion tail for local projectiles and stream producer.
Initialize a normal-child projectile with upward velocity and inherited mappings/art.
Abort for parent death, otherwise choose the fixed falling lane when vertical speed becomes nonnegative.
Teleport projectile X to the selected lane and save its lava-sample address.
Attempt one normal trail child on VInt phases divisible by four.
Move the launched projectile and use horizontal collision-draw lifetime.
Move with light gravity and compare against the saved lane lava sample.
Switch a landed projectile to stream-riding movement.
Apply parent lifetime and stopped-stream onscreen deletion before riding lava.
Move the projectile along lava and attempt its custom boss-point hit.
Initialize the second normal attack child as a following one-shot effect.
Follow the boss normal-child offset and run the one-shot multi-delay effect.
Initialize a projectile-emitted trail actor with a one-shot raw script.
Run the trail animation and reduce vertical speed before integration.
Initialize the first persistent boss graphic attachment.
Follow the boss, loop fixed-delay frames and use parent flag4 deletion.
Initialize the parent-status graphic attachment with an eight-byte partial record.
Follow parent with flips and choose normal or hit presentation.
Choose defeat frame only when parent hit-status path did not win.
Draw the selected status frame until parent flag4 requests deletion.
Test a lava-riding projectile point against its boss parent rectangle.
Attempt one explosion on self-hit or parent death before deleting the projectile.
Immediately clear the projectile and skip its immediate caller remainder.
Boss-relative offset/extent square for a projectile point test.
Store signed stream velocity after the overlapping shared direction BYTE test.
Choose one of two four-color palette rows during the self-hit latch.
Copy the selected four colors and clear hit status after BYTE countdown.
Return with no self-hit latch or after palette recovery.
Begin defeat when health reaches exact zero and stop stream activity.
Stop arena pressure growth and apply common defeat bookkeeping.
Four scatter destination addresses for boss hit flash.
Two disjoint four-WORD palette profiles.
Boss-relative square for platform-origin shatter detection.
Return false when platform origin is outside the unsigned camera viewport.
Ten static initial frames for the shattered platform pieces.
Ten signed BYTE XY offsets used at debris initialization.
Ten signed WORD x/y velocities for shattered platform pieces.
Wait for Egg Capsule opened signal and install its palette program.
Run the global palette program and maintain the original cycle counter override.
Keep palette cycle counter at0x7FFF after the program callback.
Stop this actor script-driving phase by selecting its counter-only updater.
Six-byte launched projectile descriptor.
Six-byte boss-following shot-effect descriptor.
Six-byte free-moving projectile trail descriptor.
Six-byte looping surface attachment descriptor.
Eight-byte record starting at art rather than mappings.
Full twelve-byte small platform descriptor.
Full twelve-byte large platform descriptor with the original palette mistake.
Eight-byte art-first animated overlay descriptor.
Two normal-child attachment records.
Two distinct normal children for each timed shot attempt.
One normal trail child with a positive Y offset.
One simple rising-platform child per call.
One simple overlay child attempted at platform descent transition.
Ten simple debris children with external subtype-indexed fields.
Uniform-delay raw surface-effect loop.
Eight frame/delay pairs ending in the actor custom-delete callback.
Six frame/delay pairs for a moving trail with custom deletion.
Uniform raw loop for the platform overlay.
Uniform raw loop for the full-solid large platform.
Activate the recurring placement spawner only once its origin is inside the camera.
Repeat rising-platform attempts before the boss handle is published.
Return from the common rising-platform creation helper.
Attempt a one-shot rising platform for placement subtypes1 or2.
Initialize a small top-solid platform and update it immediately.
Move the small platform and resolve riders before horizontal lifetime/drawing.
Initialize the larger full-solid animated platform.
Animate the large platform and resolve full collision at its current position.
Initialize the spawned platform rising phase and consume its first countdown immediately.
Integrate upward motion for the initial nonnegative countdown values.
Switch platform to downward speed and independently attempt its overlay.
Move downward and route subtype1 to onscreen-only lifetime.
Check shared boss and visibility, then conditionally claim the special platform.
Shared platform draw tail after visibility/claim or movement checks.
Keep subtype1 while its prior render onscreen bit remains set.
Release standing players before scheduling platform deletion.
Move the claimed platform until Y0x612, then signal arena readiness.
Check boss proximity before stream motion and stopped-stream offscreen deletion.
Move with stream velocity, resolve riders, then match lava height.
Legacy platform swing updater reached by the preceding explicitly unused initializer.
Shared legacy movement/solidity tail also installed as its stopped updater.
Initialize a producer-spawned stream platform without rising/claim setup.
Initialize the optional rising-platform overlay and follow immediately.
Copy platform XY, animate and honor parent status7.
Initialize one of ten shattered platform pieces with external full resources.
Run the shared camera and delayed miniboss-music transition.
Install battle dispatch after camera transition and load its two upper palette lines.
Shared RTS for root, arm and post-sign palette callbacks.
Dispatch one root routine state and retain the common draw continuation.
Eleven relative WORD root state entries including shared timed waits.
Initialize root resources, six-hit health and two independent twelve-link arm chains.
Wait for Nemesis queue before scheduling boss art and explosion patterns.
After the initial delay request the arm chains to rise.
Return from the initial timer gate.
Shared signed-underflow wait for arm rise, arm return or pre-slam pause.
Clear the arm-rise request and start its return interval.
Begin root upward movement with looping frame-delay animation.
Rise while phase-gated tracking Player1 horizontally, then clamp to the hover height.
Swing vertically, phase-retarget horizontally and wait for pre-slam pause.
Return after horizontal retarget gating or velocity selection.
Two signed horizontal velocities selected by Find_OtherObject side result.
Select the shared wait before the downward slam.
Start the slam frame-delay sequence and its impact callback.
Step downward by four integer pixels while the raw slam callback advances phase.
Raw callback starts solid vulnerable impact hold.
Apply solid platform contact and root hit/defeat policy during impact hold.
Start root return motion and displace players from the solid boss.
Choose active hit policy or flash-only recovery using the raw cursor BYTE.
Continue existing recovery after the early retract hit window.
Integrate retraction and check initial baseline after its current callback wait.
Return after retraction baseline comparison.
Choose long arm-rise or short retry interval after return timer expires.
Load short wait without reasserting arm-rise flags.
Attempt the post-sign palette transition watcher before debris/sign setup.
Attempt eleven normal root debris children and enter shared end-sign progression.
Initialize the second chain right-side render orientation and start delay.
Select one base, ten middle links or terminal link by actual even subtype.
Select middle-link pointer or finish terminal pointer adjustment.
Enter the selected arm initializer immediately with staggered timer.
Three LONG initializer pointers selected by chain subtype role.
Dispatch arm base movement then apply side-specific destruction and draw.
Five base states with one shared move/wait handler.
Initialize base partial attributes and fixed camera-relative start position.
React once root flag3 requests the base rise.
Return during base-rise request gate or after selecting movement.
Shared upward/downward base movement followed by signed timer wait.
Finish upward interval and wait for root flag3 to clear.
Wait until root flag3 clears before lowering the base.
Return during raised wait or after selecting downward movement.
Finish downward base interval and set root return flag2.
Initialize middle-link attributes, then suspend with its continuation captured.
Advance middle-link phase with overshoot-preserving reversal bounds.
Reverse the stored BYTE phase step after candidate exceeds the accepted interval.
Position one middle link on its preceding link before side destruction/draw.
Initialize terminal attributes, then defer weapon pointer/raw/health setup.
Wait for root flag3 before starting terminal weapon cycle.
Store side-selected initial shot wait and callback.
Apply side-destruction scheduling after idle flag test or burst setup.
Observe shared root return flag while retaining this current active update.
Run terminal weapon update and choose hit-flash visibility/touch policy.
Register terminal collision only when its hit recovery BYTE is zero.
Draw terminal weapon after zero recovery or even recovery phase.
Advance one-based projectile number and select short interval or long pause.
Attempt one orientation-adjusted projectile and override its subtype with burst count.
Return after successful projectile subtype override or failed allocation.
Initialize inherited-resource arm projectile from overridden one-based shot subtype.
Move arm projectile without gravity and apply touch-aware XY lifetime.
Initialize a short-lived hit overlay attached directly to terminal XY.
Count overlay duration and follow parent integer XY before death check.
Schedule ordinary overlay deletion when parent status7 is observed.
Initialize one of eleven root-breakup shapes and generic indexed gravity/flicker motion.
Eleven frame selectors for root-breakup normal children.
Wait for end-level flag before starting custom-completion palette transition.
Run the global palette program and retain the current camera-exit check.
Wait for camera X0x940 before clamping minimum and retiring palette controller.
Custom palette callback changes controller to camera-check-only mode.
Independent watcher restores level line2 and miniboss-after palette lines3/4.
Copy normal palette line2 then restore64-byte upper-line palette.
Copy sixteen LONGs from selected palette to normal lines3/4.
Schedule one linked segment destruction according to root side flag.
Timer callback attempts explosion and changes next callback to scheduled deletion.
Return after optional segment explosion without undoing delete wait.
Return after one-based projectile velocity setup and optional horizontal reversal.
Three packed signed x/y velocity WORD pairs for the first burst shots.
Finish side-selected one-time base placement.
Select root hit-flash source with the literal wrong byte displacement.
Copy selected root colors, count recovery and restore original collision size at zero.
Return when root collision gate rejects hit handling or flash progresses.
Commit root defeat and request destruction of both arm chains.
Six normal-line2 destination addresses for scatter color writes.
Two stored six-color profiles with actual overlapping parity selection.
Continue existing retract flash without restoring collision at completion.
Return after absent or continuing retract flash.
Count terminal hit recovery and restore collision at expiry.
Shared terminal hit-policy return.
Select root side bit6/7 after terminal health reaches zero.
Set this root side flag and shorten root timer only when both sides are flagged.

One adjusted normal projectile at signed X offset 8.
One inherited-resource simple overlay on new terminal hit recovery.
Eleven normal root-breakup children with explicit signed BYTE positions.
Root rise frame-delay loop selected by stored actor pointer.
Short slam frame-delay stream ending in configured impact callback.
